requirements.text: **This is not:** a recovery package, implementation patch, deployment instruction, or repository mutation.
requirements.implementationStatus: planning alignment; verify through #126 integration receipt

requirements.text: The first functioning local private beta made Tocyn's operator workflow visible as a complete product rather than as isolated implementation tasks. That review exposed severe product-level UI/UX problems which were outside the deliberately bounded acceptance of the first-beta work.
requirements.implementationStatus: planning alignment; verify through #126 integration receipt

requirements.text: This package converts those observations into a complete, traceable project-plan change set. It does not compress the findings into a short priority list. Every negative finding from the beta review is carried into one or more explicit remediation items, acceptance gates, existing-issue amendments, new-issue proposals, ADRs, documentation changes, or later-roadmap dependencies.
requirements.implementationStatus: planning alignment; verify through #126 integration receipt

requirements.text: The problem is not primarily the current component library.
requirements.implementationStatus: planning alignment; verify through #126 integration receipt

requirements.text: The current operator experience is built around a **ticket-record mental model**:
requirements.implementationStatus: planning alignment; verify through #126 integration receipt

requirements.text: `ticket table -> full ticket route -> work ticket -> Back to Tickets -> reconstruct queue context`
requirements.implementationStatus: planning alignment; verify through #126 integration receipt

requirements.text: The target must become a **continuous operator-workspace mental model**:
requirements.implementationStatus: planning alignment; verify through #126 integration receipt

requirements.text: `work view remains visible -> select conversation -> understand -> act -> resolve/snooze -> advance -> context persists`
requirements.implementationStatus: planning alignment; verify through #126 integration receipt

requirements.text: Ark/Zag headless primitives remain an appropriate implementation foundation, but issue #48 must not blindly migrate obsolete interaction structures and thereby make the wrong workflow more polished.
requirements.implementationStatus: implementation pending; existing foundations do not satisfy new acceptance

requirements.text: The repository documentation records the local-only private-beta testing boundary as accepted on 9 September 2026. The accepted beta used Wrangler/local resources, synthetic tenants and locally captured authentication mail. It grants no production or public-release authority.
requirements.implementationStatus: planning alignment; verify through #126 integration receipt
